app_tagline: One place to manage every agent's model list
apply_hint: A snapshot of the target agent's config is taken first. Models with the same id are overwritten; every other field is left untouched.
sidebar_agents_hint: Disabled agents are never written to
cache_empty_desc: This is your local cache of models. Add an upstream, pull its model list, and the cached models can be written to any agent in one click.
cache_remove_confirm: Remove this model from the cache? The agents' config files are left untouched.
btn_backups_hint: Browse snapshot history of this agent's config
fetch_loading: Asking the upstream for its model list…
fetch_hint: The selected models are written to the target agent config; a snapshot is taken first.
fetch_hint_cache: The selected models are added to the local cache. No agent config is touched.
fetch_need_upstream: This group does not belong to a cached upstream, so it cannot be cached.
upstream_editor_desc: Fill in the endpoint and key, then pull the model list
upstream_fetch_hint: Once the endpoint and key are filled in, hit Pull to fetch the upstream's model list and tick what you want.
upstream_edit_saved_hint: Skip pulling to keep the existing list
upstream_desc: An upstream is an endpoint plus key. Pulling caches its models into the local list, ready to push to any agent.
upstream_empty: No upstreams yet. Use "Import from agents" to pull in what your configs already use, or add one by hand.
upstream_confirm_delete: Remove this upstream from the catalog? The agents' config files are not affected.
upstream_import_desc: Scan first, then decide what to keep
upstream_import_hint: Upstreams found in your agents' configs. Only the ticked ones are added.
upstream_nothing_found: No upstreams found in any agent config.
empty_desc: No models were found in this agent's config file, or the file does not exist yet. Add one and BuddySwitch will create the file for you.
model_id_hint: Must match the identifier the agent expects, e.g. gpt-4o-mini
model_enabled_hint: This plugin's config has no enable flag, so the state is kept locally by BuddySwitch.
plugin_source_hint: Leave empty to use the paths from the plugin definition
setting_backup_keep_desc: A snapshot is taken before every write; older ones are pruned automatically.
backup_desc: A snapshot is captured before every write to the agent config. Restoring also snapshots the current content first, so a restore is itself undoable.
backup_empty: No snapshots yet. They appear here as soon as you change a model.
backup_confirm_restore: Overwrite the current model config with this snapshot? The current content will be saved as a new snapshot first.
backup_confirm_clear: Delete every snapshot of this plugin? This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete: Delete this model? It writes straight to the agent config (a snapshot is taken first).
manual_add_hint: For models the upstream's list does not include
manual_add_why: Some upstreams return an incomplete model list, so anything you cannot pull has to be typed in.
upstream_manual_hint: One per line: "model id" or "model id | display name". Use this when the upstream list is incomplete.
cache_group_empty: No models under this upstream yet — use Pull or Add manually.
agent_group_empty: No models under this endpoint yet.
probe_msg_not_found: Endpoint not found (404). Check the endpoint.
probe_msg_unexpected: The server returned an unexpected status
probe_msg_no_base_url: This model has no base_url, cannot probe
probe_msg_body_failed: Failed to build the request body: %s
err_container_not_found: No model array found in %s; schema.container tried %v
err_root_not_array: The file root is not an array; adjust schema.container in the plugin definition
err_container_not_array: schema.container=%s does not point to an array
err_container_needs_object: Container path %s requires the file root to be an object
err_no_listing_spec: No usable model-list interface is defined
err_listing_url_empty: The endpoint is empty; cannot request the model list
err_listing_timeout: Timed out requesting the model list (%s)
err_upstream_no_listing: The upstream has no model-list endpoint (404): %s
err_parse_upstream_failed: Failed to parse the upstream response
err_response_no_array: No model array in the response (array_path=%s)
err_response_array_type: The model list in the response is not an array; check listing.array_path
err_plugin_missing_field: Plugin %s schema.fields is missing required field %s
err_plugin_no_source: No usable config file path resolved for plugin %s
err_create_plugin_dir: Failed to create the plugin directory
err_no_writable_model: No writable models (all ids are empty)
err_write_state_failed: Failed to write the state file
err_create_backup_dir: Failed to create the backup directory
err_upstream_url_empty: The upstream endpoint URL cannot be empty
err_entry_not_object: The native entry is not an object, cannot write back: %v
err_read_builtin_failed: Failed to read the built-in plugins
